answer.rationale: This is one key compared with itself, so the stated countries (ES and FR) never meet on a single record, and the evidence cannot tell whether one teacher travels between France, Spain and Germany or several people share the single name Azzedine; the URBAN KIZ/URBANKIZ and Kizomba styles recur across events, which suggests one artist, but the country-to-event mismatches leave it unsettled.
